title: Screens and help articles (inventory.json)
description: The input of tour-inventory and help-refs (standard/help-system.md, "The tour manifest"): every screen by its key, whether the menu reaches it, and its help article's numbered tasks in order, each naming the tour that shows it and the anchor ids of the controls it mentions. A project writes it, or generates it from its help content folder and its menu.

recordAnchors.description: The anchors of this screen that sit on a person's record or row. List every data-tour id that one person's record or row carries: the row and each control on it, an appointment (the plain id a resolver picks among, such as cal.appointment, as well as the resolver's own id), every control inside a window, card or sheet opened on one person (her appointment, payment, chat, document), and every control that acts on several people's records at once (select all, a bulk send or charge), and every id whose element holds people's rows or records (a list, a column, the calendar grid), since a do step lit on it lets her press any of them. A print or an export of many people's records changes none and tells no one, so it is not listed (cal.print); sending or sharing it tells someone, a T step. Anchor ids are global: an id listed on one screen counts on every screen. A do step on one of them with on: none is a finding. The project declares them; that the list is complete is judged in the running app.

viewOf.description: This key is a view of that screen (the calendar's day view of its week): a core entry may group a screen's views, and they count as one core screen.

menu.description: The screen is reachable from the menu.

tasks.description: The article's numbered tasks, in their order.

text.description: The task's name, as the tours list it in tasks.

tour.description: The tour that shows this task (its first chapter for a job).

anchors.description: The anchor ids of the controls the task's text mentions.
